answer_1.quote: We propose that an LLM's Consistency-quantified by the variance measured in its pairwise decisions when acting as a judge-can serve as a proxy for measuring its own Elo score.
models: 24 LLMs with Elo scores ranging from 1008 to 1315
answer_1.outputs: pairs of responses from LLMs to user prompts

answer_2.quote: We introduce Consistency scores as a simple, scalable metric for estimating LLM intelligence by measuring a model's consistency in preferring the same winner in repeated pairwise matchups.

answer_3.quote: researchers have turned to LLMs-as-Judges, replacing human evaluators with high-performing LLMs.
models: 24 LLMs selected across a range of Elo scores
